tools.name: recoversolrent.scan_solana
tools.description: Read public Solana account state and identify empty token accounts, possible dust balances, possible NFTs, and current rent held by each account. This never creates or signs a transaction.

tools.name: recoversolrent.get_pricing
tools.description: Return the disclosed success fee, atomic on-chain referral split, and whether fee collection is configured.

tools.name: recoversolrent.get_supported_chains
tools.description: Return the single supported recovery network and its execution boundary.

tools.name: recoversolrent.get_methodology
tools.description: Return the product safety boundary, exact-versus-estimate policy, and canonical documentation links.
